scenes.name: RATCHET
lines: A ratchet turns one way. In prose, an eloquent mistake can survive for decades; in Lean four, the kernel rejects it on the spot.
棘轮只朝一个方向咬合。散文里，雄辩的错误能活几十年；Lean 4 的内核当场拒收。
Every theorem added to a catalog intersects the joint kernel of indistinguishable states—blind spots can shrink, never grow.
每向目录加入一条定理，不可分辨状态对的联合核就取一次交——盲区只缩不胀。

scenes.name: NOVELTY
lines: More subtly, on a nondegenerate arena, a theorem lowers information escape if and only if it stands outside the semantic closure of what is already known.
在非退化竞技场上，定理降低信息逃逸，当且仅当它落在已有结论的语义闭包之外。
You cannot mine the same gold twice.
同一块金子，挖不了两次。

scenes.name: FRONTIER
lines: Across seven hundred twenty unbroken UTC hours, commits to trureturing never stopped; its cumulative snapshot holds one hundred sixty-seven thousand frozen theorems, and over seventy-four days it logged two thousand one hundred twenty-six dated literature resolutions—two thousand one hundred twenty-eight in total.
七百二十 UTC 小时提交从未间断；trureturing 累计快照冻结十六万七千余条定理，七十四天里登记两千一百二十六道带日期文献题解，合计两千一百二十八道。
From proving four-qubit entropy bounds to refuting the four-qubit Fredkin entangling-power conjecture—and marking what remains open in stark red.
从证明四量子比特熵上界，到反驳四量子比特 Fredkin 纠缠能力猜想——同时以红色醒目标出尚未攻克的边界。
